result.texto: Common Questions About Tramontina Cookware, Bakeware, Cutlery, and More What kitchen products does Tramontina make? Tramontina makes , , and , plus and kitchen tools. As a vertically integrated manufacturer founded in 1911, it produces these lines in its own factories, from stainless steel pans to forged knives. cookware bakeware cutlery tableware What pots and pans does Tramontina offer? The Tramontina cookware range covers every core pot and pan: , , , , and . You can buy pieces individually or as . fry pans and skillets sauce pans and sauciers saute pans stock pots and multi-cookers enameled cast iron Dutch ovens cookware sets What is Tramontina cookware made of? Tramontina cookware comes in several materials, each suited to a different job: and tri-ply clad for even heat and control, for braising and baking, for high-heat searing, and aluminum with a for quick, low-effort cooking. stainless steel enameled cast iron carbon steel nonstick coating Where is Tramontina cookware made? Tramontina is a vertically integrated company founded in Brazil in 1911, where it manufactures many of its products. Its U.S. operation, Tramontina USA, has been based in Sugar Land, Texas since 1986. Making pieces in its own facilities lets the company hold consistent quality standards across every category. Does Tramontina cookware come with a warranty? Many Tramontina cookware and cutlery lines carry a limited lifetime warranty against defects in material and workmanship, and select lines list their own terms. Coverage varies by collection, so check the specific product page for the details that apply. Is Tramontina cookware induction compatible? Much of Tramontina's and is induction compatible, including the Signature and Tempo tri-ply lines. Aluminum nonstick lines such as the PRO Series are not induction ready, so look for the induction symbol on the product page. stainless steel cast iron cookware Is Tramontina cookware oven safe? Yes, many Tramontina pieces are oven safe. Limits generally range from about 350°F / 176°C to 500°F / 260°C depending on the collection and its lid and handle, so check the specific product page for the exact temperature. Is Tramontina cookware dishwasher safe? Most Tramontina cookware is dishwasher safe, including the lines. should be hand washed, and hand washing any piece with a non-abrasive sponge helps it last longer. stainless steel cookware Cast iron and enameled cast iron Is Tramontina ceramic cookware non-toxic? Tramontina is made without intentionally added PTFE, PFOA, PFAS, lead, and cadmium. The ceramic coating releases food easily for everyday cooking, and using silicone, wood, or nylon utensils keeps the surface in good condition. ceramic cookware Where can I buy Tramontina cookware?
